props.name: label
props.description: Always required: it is the label that animates.

props.name: animateFrom
props.description: Edge the label grows from. Match it to the FAB's own corner.

props.name: duration
props.description: Animation duration (ms).

props.name: extended
props.description:
`true` shows the label, `false` collapses to the icon. Drive it from a
scroll offset to get the M3 "shrink on scroll" behaviour.

props.name: iconMode
props.description:
`static` keeps the icon put and slides the label out beside it.
`dynamic` lets the icon travel with the label as the pill grows.

props.name: placement
props.description: `inline` drops the absolute positioning (toolbar, card action row).

props.name: back
props.description: Truthy when a back destination exists (native-stack passes { title, href })

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height — `16 / 9`, `1`, `4 / 3`. Defaults to `1`.

props.name: value
props.description: The text in the field. Free text is allowed — this is not a Select.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear button once there is text. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Omit to hide the list instead.

props.name: filter
props.description:
Custom matcher. Defaults to a case- and accent-insensitive substring test
over `label`. Pass `() => true` when the options are filtered server-side.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in the field — for options still being fetched.

props.name: maxSuggestions
props.description: Caps the visible suggestions. Defaults to 8.

props.name: minChars
props.description: Characters required before suggestions appear. Defaults to 1.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape: full circle, rounded corners, or square.

props.name: max
props.description: Cap shown as "max+" when count exceeds it.

props.name: showZero
props.description: Render the badge even when count is 0 (hidden by default).

props.name: actions
props.description: Up to two actions, rendered right-aligned below the message.

props.name: dismissable
props.description: Show a close (X) button; requires onDismiss.

props.name: maxHeightRatio
props.description: Max sheet height as a fraction of the window height.

props.name: bg
props.description: Background — an M3 color role name or a raw color.

props.name: m
props.description: Margin on every edge.

props.name: p
props.description: Padding on every edge.

props.name: px
props.description: Horizontal padding.

props.name: py
props.description: Vertical padding.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: row
props.description: Lays children out horizontally instead of vertically.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse middle items behind an ellipsis when exceeding this count.

props.name: busy
props.description:
Blocks presses and announces the button as busy, but — unlike `loading` —
keeps the label, the icon and the full-strength colours on screen.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the press to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill the parent width.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Icon side relative to the label.

props.name: labelStyle
props.description: Applied to the label text, after the theme's type style.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Colour role. `error` is the destructive treatment (delete, discard);
`success` is confirmation feedback, from a fixed green kept off the seed.

props.name: underlay
props.description:
Drawn behind the label across the whole surface, clipped to its shape:
a progress fill, a state animation. It receives no touches.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value, or the selected values with `multiSelect`.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the group for assistive tech.

props.name: mode
props.description: Look of the unselected buttons; selected ones are filled. Defaults to `"tonal"`.

props.name: size
props.description: Defaults to `"s"` (40dp).

props.name: type
props.description:
`"standard"` spaces the buttons apart; `"connected"` joins them into one
control (the successor of segmented buttons). Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description:
Moves keyboard focus into the calendar when it mounts, so the arrow keys
work at once. Web only. The date pickers set it; leave it off for a
calendar that is part of a page.

props.name: dates
props.description: Selected days in `multiple` mode.

props.name: endYear
props.description: Last year reachable from the year grid and the endless scroller.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Defaults to the locale's own week start.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Excludes days `validRange` cannot express (weekends, computed holidays).

props.name: keyboardNavigation
props.description:
Arrow-key/PageUp/Home/Enter navigation. Web only — there is no key event
source on native. Default `true`.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting/labelling locale. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires in `single` mode.

props.name: onDatesChange
props.description: Fires in `multiple` mode with the full set after the tap.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Fires in `range` mode with the interval after the tap.

props.name: onRequestClose
props.description: Called on Escape while keyboard navigation is active.

props.name: range
props.description: Selected interval in `range` mode.

props.name: scrollMode
props.description:
`endless` scrolls through months in one virtualized list; `paged` shows one
month at a time behind the chevrons. Defaults to `endless`.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: How many days the grid collects. Defaults to `"single"`.

props.name: showToday
props.description: Renders the "Today" shortcut row. Default `true`.

props.name: startYear
props.description: First year reachable from the year grid and the endless scroller.

props.name: validRange
props.description: The selectable window plus individual excluded days.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected day in `single` mode.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the buttons sit on the row. M3 puts card actions on the right.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text — an unnamed image is invisible to a screen reader.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height. M3 card covers default to 16:9.

props.name: left
props.description: Leading slot — an `Avatar`, an `Icon`, a `StatusBadge`.

props.name: right
props.description: Trailing slot — an `IconButton`, a `Menu` anchor, a `Chip`.

props.name: autoPlayInterval
props.description: Auto-advance interval in ms; 0 disables auto-play.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height; otherwise sized by the tallest page.

props.name: showArrows
props.description: Overlay prev/next arrow buttons.

props.name: bg
props.description: Background — an M3 color role name or a raw color.

props.name: m
props.description: Margin on every edge.

props.name: p
props.description: Padding on every edge.

props.name: px
props.description: Horizontal padding.

props.name: py
props.description: Vertical padding.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: row
props.description: Lays children out horizontally instead of vertically.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the toggle to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Mixed state (e.g. "select all" with partial selection); overrides the checkmark.

props.name: accessibilityRole
props.description:
Overrides the role of a pressable chip (`"button"`). A chip that toggles
inside a group is a `"radio"` or a `"checkbox"`, and then reports
`selected` as checked.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report presses: a `"checkbox"` chip toggles, a `"radio"` one selects to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: size
props.description: "small" renders a compact 24px chip.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value (or `null`), or the selected values with `multiSelect`.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the group for assistive tech.

props.name: mode
props.description: Chip look. Defaults to `"outlined"`, the M3 filter chip.

props.name: multiSelect
props.description: Filter chips: any number selected. Defaults to `false` (one at most).

props.name: required
props.description: Single select only: the selected chip cannot be deselected.

props.name: wrap
props.description: `true` wraps onto more lines; `false` scrolls sideways. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: hours
props.description: Current hour, always 0–23 regardless of the displayed clock format.

props.name: isTimeDisabled
props.description: Greys out and refuses values the caller does not allow.

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity the dial snaps to. Defaults to 1.

props.name: onUnitComplete
props.description: Fires when a press on the hour dial ends, to hand over to the minutes.

props.name: use24HourClock
props.description: Renders two rings (1–12 outer, 13–00 inner) instead of one.

props.name: inputType
props.description: `picker` shows the dial, `keyboard` two text fields. Defaults to `picker`.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting locale; decides 12h vs 24h. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: maximumDate
props.description: Clamps the selectable times on the maximum's own day.

props.name: minimumDate
props.description: Clamps the selectable times on the minimum's own day.

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity. Defaults to 1.

props.name: use24HourClock
props.description: Forces the 24-hour face. Left unset, the locale decides.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the content is expanded.

props.name: animateOpacity
props.description: Fades the content along with the height change. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: collapsedHeight
props.description: Height kept visible while collapsed — a peek/teaser. Defaults to 0.

props.name: duration
props.description: Transition length in ms. Defaults to 200.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Skips unmounting the children while collapsed. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown centered when data is empty and not loading.

props.name: value
props.description: `null` renders `placeholder` instead of a formatted value.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear affordance to the field. Needs `onClear` to do anything.

props.name: defaultInputType
props.description: Which surface the dialog opens on. Default `"picker"`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the picker already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: endYear
props.description: Last year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years on.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the field; also recolors the field.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Defaults to the locale's own week start.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: inputEnabled
props.description: Lets the user type the value straight into the field. Default `true`.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Excludes days `validRange` cannot express (weekends, a computed holiday set).

props.name: labels
props.description: Chrome strings of the picker surface (nav buttons, "Today", "Clear", …).

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides the formatting/labelling locale. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity of the clock. Defaults to 1.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field has no value.

props.name: relativeLabels

Overrides the relative day labels, e.g. from i18n:

props.name: children
props.description:
Centred label, splitting the rule in two. Horizontal only — a vertical
divider is a bare rule.

props.name: contentSpacing
props.description: Gap between the label and each half of the rule. No label, no gap.

props.name: inset
props.description: Margin at both ends of the line, along its own axis.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Line thickness, in pixels.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the press to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the control. Its presence marks the group invalid.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the control; hidden while `error` is set.

props.name: columns
props.description: Fixed column count. Ignored when `minChildWidth` is set.

props.name: minChildWidth
props.description:
Responsive alternative to `columns`: fits as many columns of at least this
width as the container allows.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Gap between cells — a spacing token name or a raw value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the text to match a disabled field.

props.name: padding
props.description: `none` removes the 16px gutter that aligns the text with the field body.

props.name: type
props.description: `error` switches to the error role and shows the alert glyph.

props.name: visible
props.description: Fades the text out instead of unmounting it, so the field doesn't jump.

props.name: flipForRTL
props.description: Mirror the glyph when the layout direction is RTL (arrows, chevrons).

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Required: an icon alone carries no accessible name.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the press (a toggle when `selected` is set) to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: mode
props.description: M3 icon-button container styles. Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: selected
props.description: Renders the M3 "selected" container of a toggle icon button.

props.name: alt
props.description:
Alternative text. Required — an image with no accessible name is invisible
to screen readers.

props.name: fallbackIcon
props.description: Shown when loading fails and there is no `fallbackSource`.

props.name: fallbackSource
props.description: Swapped in when `source` fails to load.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height. Use instead of `height` for fluid layouts.

props.name: showLoader
props.description: Renders a pulsing skeleton until the image resolves. Defaults to `true`.

Input.name: Input
Input.description: Every `TextInput` prop passes through, except the ones Input owns.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label with an asterisk.

props.name: allowedSchemes
props.description:
URL schemes `href` may use. A link whose `href` came from data (a user's
website, a CMS field) must not be able to open `javascript:`, `intent:` or
another app's deep link. Add your own app's scheme here to deep-link.
Defaults to `["http", "https", "mailto", "tel"]`.

props.name: href
props.description:
Opened with `Linking.openURL`. Ignored when `onPress` is given, and when
its scheme is not in `allowedSchemes` — then the link does nothing.

props.name: showExternalIcon
props.description: Appends an external-link icon. Defaults to `true` when `href` is remote.

props.name: underline
props.description: Underline behaviour. Defaults to `"hover"`.

props.name: variant
props.description: M3 typography variant for the label. Defaults to `"bodyMedium"`.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading slot — an Avatar, an icon, a Checkbox.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Second line below `children`.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Trailing slot — a value, a Toggle, a chevron.

props.name: divider
props.description: Rule below the section, for a settings screen of stacked groups.

props.name: title
props.description: Group label rendered above the rows as a heading.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the menu automatically after an item is pressed. Default true.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Renders the confirm action in the error tone (delete, discard).

props.name: dismissable
props.description:
Whether the scrim and ESC cancel the dialog. Leave it off for a decision
the user must answer explicitly. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Hero glyph above the title.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the dialog is on screen.

props.name: actions
props.description:
Trailing action row. Replaces the single `closeText` button. In a
full-screen dialog it moves into the header, after the title.

props.name: dismissable
props.description:
Whether tapping the scrim (and pressing ESC on web) dismisses the dialog.
Turn it off for a decision the user must not be able to skip.
Defaults to `true`.

props.name: fullScreen
props.description:
The M3 full-screen dialog, for a form on a compact window: it fills the
window, with a close button, the title and `actions` in a header row and
a scrolling body. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Hero glyph above the title (M3 dialog icon). Centres the header.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called on Android back / ESC without rendering the close button. Falls back to onClose.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Scrolls the body when the content is taller than the dialog.

props.name: testID
props.description: Root testID. The scrim gets `${testID}-scrim`.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: "always" shows every label, "selected" only the active one.

props.name: children
props.description: `DrawerSection`s and/or `DrawerItem`s.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned below the scrolling items.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Modal only: called on scrim press, Android back and Escape (web).

props.name: title
props.description: Headline at the top of the drawer.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"standard"` is an inline panel to place beside the content (expanded
windows and up). `"modal"` slides over the content with a scrim.
Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: visible
props.description: Modal only: whether the drawer is open.

props.name: width
props.description: Defaults to 360 (M3), capped at the window width when modal.

props.name: activeId
props.description: `id` of the current destination.

props.name: items
props.description: Destinations, same shape as `NavigationBar`'s. Three to seven per M3.

props.name: alignment
props.description: Where the destinations sit vertically. Defaults to `"top"`.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned to the bottom of the rail.

props.name: header
props.description: Above the destinations: typically a menu `IconButton` and/or a `FAB`.

props.name: showLabels
props.description:
`"always"` labels every destination, `"selected"` only the active one,
`"none"` none (the label is still the accessible name). Defaults to `"always"`.

props.name: page
props.description: Current page, 1-based.

props.name: showFirstLast
props.description: Show jump-to-first / jump-to-last arrows.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Cell edge length. Defaults to 48.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the cells; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of cells. Defaults to 6.

props.name: mask
props.description: Renders dots instead of characters.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fired once the last cell is filled.

props.name: type
props.description: Restricts the accepted characters. Defaults to `"numeric"`.

props.name: color
props.description: Indicator colour. Defaults to `primary`.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hides it from assistive tech when something else announces the progress.

props.name: duration
props.description: Indeterminate only: one revolution, in ms.

props.name: progress
props.description:
Completion from 0 to 1. Set, the ring fills to it over a track; unset,
the indicator spins (indeterminate).

props.name: decorative
props.description:
Hide the bar from assistive technology, for when the component around it
already announces the progress — a bar inside a button is not a second
control to land on.

props.name: height
props.description: Bar thickness. A percentage fills the parent — a progress surface.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name while idle. Falls back to the label.

props.name: children
props.description: The idle label. Also the loading label unless `loadingLabel` is set.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of each progress step's transition, in ms.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: Label once the task failed. The button stays pressable, to retry.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Leading icon while idle and loading.

props.name: indicator
props.description:
How progress is drawn inside the surface: `fill` sweeps a darker (or, in
the dark scheme, lighter) tone of the button across it; `bar` runs a 4dp
line along its bottom edge.

props.name: labelStyle
props.description: Applied to the label: font family, size, weight.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Label while loading, e.g. "Calculating route…".

props.name: onPress
props.description: Fires in every status but `loading`, where the button is busy.

props.name: onSuccessEnd
props.description: Called `successDuration` ms after the button turned to success.

props.name: progress
props.description:
Completion while `status` is `"loading"`, from 0 to 1. Leave it undefined
when the task cannot say how far along it is, for an indeterminate sweep.

props.name: progressColor
props.description: Colour of the fill or the bar. Derived from the button's colours if unset.

props.name: status
props.description:
Which moment of the task to show. Controlled: the button never moves
itself from one status to the next — the caller does, as the task reports.

props.name: style
props.description: Applied to the surface: corner radius, padding, width.

props.name: successDuration
props.description:
How long the success status holds before `onSuccessEnd` fires, in ms.
`0` keeps it until the caller changes `status`.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: Label once the task succeeded.

props.name: trackColor
props.description: Colour behind the bar, and behind the fill on outlined and text.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the selection to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: value
props.description: Current rating; halves are rendered (e.g. 3.5).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Interactive when provided; tapping a star sets a whole value.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button empties the field.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the option list already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called by the close button, and in modal mode by the scrim, Android back and Escape.

props.name: actions
props.description: A row of buttons at the bottom, below a divider.

props.name: modal
props.description:
`true` slides over the content with a scrim; `false` is a standard sheet
you place in a row beside the content. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Shows a back button before the title — for a sheet with sub-pages.

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Defaults to `true`.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge it attaches to, in reading direction. Defaults to `"end"`.

props.name: visible
props.description: Modal only: whether the sheet is open.

props.name: width
props.description: Defaults to 360, capped at the window width.

props.name: animate
props.description: false renders a static placeholder (no pulse).

props.name: duration
props.description: Pulse animation duration for a full cycle (ms).

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report each step the thumb crosses to `ThemeProvider`'s
`onInteractionFeedback` (haptics), as a selection. Only with a `step`: a
continuous slider would report every pixel. Defaults to true.

props.name: marks
props.description: Draw a tick at every step (requires step > 0).

props.name: axis
props.description: Which axis `size` applies to. Defaults to `"vertical"`.

props.name: size
props.description: Fixed size along the parent's axis. Omit to absorb the leftover space.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the action stack already expanded. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: children
props.description: The primary action's label.

props.name: items
props.description: The related actions the trailing half opens.

props.name: onPress
props.description: The primary action.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Leading icon of the primary action.

props.name: menuAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the trailing half. Defaults to `"More options"`.

props.name: mode
props.description: Defaults to `"filled"`.

props.name: direction
props.description: Stacking axis. Defaults to `"vertical"`.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverses the visual order without touching the children array.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Gap between children — a spacing token name or a raw value.

props.name: label
props.description: What the number measures.

props.name: value
props.description: The number itself; pre-formatted by the caller.

props.name: delta
props.description: Signed change shown next to an up/down arrow, e.g. `"12.5%"`.

props.name: helpText
props.description: Extra context under the value.

props.name: invertTrendColors
props.description: Inverts the trend colors, for metrics where down is good.

props.name: trend
props.description: Direction of `delta`. Drives both the arrow and its color.

props.name: value
props.description: `null` renders `placeholder` instead of a formatted value.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear affordance to the field. Needs `onClear` to do anything.

props.name: defaultInputType
props.description: Which surface the dialog opens on. Default `"picker"`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the picker already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: endYear
props.description: Last year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years on.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the field; also recolors the field.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Defaults to the locale's own week start.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: inputEnabled
props.description: Lets the user type the value straight into the field. Default `true`.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Excludes days `validRange` cannot express (weekends, a computed holiday set).

props.name: labels
props.description: Chrome strings of the picker surface (nav buttons, "Today", "Clear", …).

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides the formatting/labelling locale. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity of the clock. Defaults to 1.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field has no value.

props.name: relativeLabels
props.description:
Overrides the relative day labels, e.g. from i18n:
`relativeLabels={{ today: t("TODAY"), yesterday: t("YESTERDAY") }}`.
Defaults to the device locale via Intl.RelativeTimeFormat.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends an asterisk to the label.

props.name: scrollMode
props.description: Month navigation inside the dialog. Default `"endless"`.

props.name: startYear
props.description: First year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years back.

props.name: use24HourClock
props.description: Forces the 24-hour clock face. Left unset, the locale decides.

props.name: validRange
props.description: The selectable window plus individual excluded days.

props.name: containerStyle
props.description: Style for the outer Pressable.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the switch to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: height
props.description: Track height; the thumb scales with it. Defaults to 18.

props.name: width
props.description: Track width. Defaults to 32.

props.name: accessibilityRole
props.description: Accessibility role. The group sets this per its selection mode.

props.name: grow
props.description: Stretch to an equal share of the group's width.

props.name: showSelectedCheck
props.description:
Swap the leading glyph for a check mark while selected — the M3 segmented
button affordance that tells "selected" apart from "just highlighted".

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the group for assistive tech — a group of choices needs a question.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every segment.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report each press (a toggle with `multiSelect`, else a selection) to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Segments share the row equally instead of sizing to their labels.

props.name: showSelectedCheck
props.description: Show a check mark on the selected segments (M3 segmented button).

props.name: children
props.description: The actions: `IconButton`s, a `Button`, a `SplitButton`.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the toolbar for assistive tech.

props.name: color
props.description:
Floating only. `"standard"` is `surfaceContainer`; `"vibrant"` is
`primaryContainer` — give its actions `onPrimaryContainer` content.
Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: fab
props.description: Floating only: a FAB beside the toolbar, as M3 pairs them.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Floating only. Defaults to `"horizontal"`.

props.name: safeArea
props.description: Docked only: pads the bottom safe-area inset. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"docked"` spans the width of the screen's bottom edge (it replaces the
bottom app bar); `"floating"` is a pill that floats over the content.
Defaults to `"docked"`.

props.name: content
props.description: The tip's text; the body text of a rich tooltip.

props.name: action
props.description:
Rich only: a text button. A rich tooltip with an action stays open while
the pointer is over it (web) and until the action is taken or the anchor
is long-pressed again (native).

props.name: enterDelay
props.description:
Hover dwell (ms) before the tip appears on web. Without it, sweeping the
pointer across a toolbar flashes every tooltip in the row.

props.name: hideDelay
props.description: Auto-hide delay (ms) after long-press on native.

props.name: leaveDelay
props.description: Grace period (ms) before the tip leaves on hover-out.

props.name: title
props.description: Rich only: the subhead.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"plain"` is the one-line label for an icon-only control. `"rich"` adds a
`title` and an `action`, for context a label cannot carry. Defaults to
`"plain"`.

props.name: actions
props.description: After the title: up to three action `IconButton`s per M3.

props.name: divider
props.description: A hairline under the bar.

props.name: elevated
props.description: The on-scroll state: `surfaceContainer` instead of `surface`.

props.name: leading
props.description: Before the title: typically a back or menu `IconButton`.

props.name: safeArea
props.description: Pads the top safe-area inset. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A second line under the title.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"small"` and `"center"` keep the title in the 64dp row; `"medium"` and
`"large"` move it to a second, larger line. Defaults to `"small"`.

props.name: activeStyle
props.description: Extra style applied only while hovered (web) or pressed.

props.name: borderless
props.description: Skip the container background so the layer only tints the child.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Matches the parent's corner radius so the layer doesn't bleed out.

props.name: rippleColor
props.description:
Colour of the state layer itself — the M3 "on" role of the surface.
Defaults to `onSurface`.

props.name: underlayColor
props.description: Surface the state layer is drawn over. Defaults to `surface`.

props.name: variant
props.description: M3 type-scale role. Defaults to `"displayLarge"`.

props.name: initialPalette
props.description:
The colour set to start on — one of `palettes`, or anything
`createPalette` returns. Read once, on mount: call `setPalette` from
`useTheme()` to change it afterwards.

props.name: onInteractionFeedback
props.description:
Called when the user presses, toggles or selects through one of the
library's controls: wire it to haptics (`@its/glowup-device/haptics`'s
`hapticFeedback`) or anything else. A control opts out with
`feedback={false}`. Without it a nested provider inherits the outer one's.

props.name: badge
props.description: Trailing text, e.g. an unread count: `24`, `"100+"`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading glyph. The active state strips an "-outline" suffix.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether this is the current destination.

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Draws a divider above the section — between it and the one before.

props.name: title
props.description: Section headline.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report each selection to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: bg
props.description: Background — an M3 color role name or a raw color.

props.name: m
props.description: Margin on every edge.

props.name: p
props.description: Padding on every edge.

props.name: px
props.description: Horizontal padding.

props.name: py
props.description: Vertical padding.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverses the visual order without touching the children array.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Gap between children — a spacing token name or a raw value.
